title: AI Engineering
logo: <svg width="26" height="26" viewBox="0 0 26 26" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 17C5 8 21 8 21 17" fill="none" stroke="var(--accent)" stroke-width="1.6"/><path d="M5 17C5 12 13 12 13 17" fill="none" stroke="var(--ink)" stroke-width="1.4" opacity=".55"/><rect x="2" y="16" width="6" height="6" rx="1.8" fill="var(--ink)"/><rect x="10" y="16" width="6" height="6" rx="1.8" fill="var(--ink)"/><rect x="18" y="16" width="6" height="6" rx="1.8" fill="var(--accent)"/></svg>
description: A self-paced AI engineering course: model calls and tokens, embeddings and retrieval, prompting, LLM internals, fine-tuning, reasoning and agents, evals, and running LLM apps in production.
hero: How modern AI systems work, one lesson at a time.

parts.t: The job and the model call
LLMs and how to steer them
Inference and fine-tuning for app engineers

modules.name: Start here: the AI engineering map
modules.desc: What the job is, the stack, one model call end to end, tokens, and choosing a model.

modules.name: Embeddings and retrieval
modules.desc: Embeddings, vector compression, ANN indexes, and choosing or fine-tuning an embedding model.

modules.name: LLM foundations
modules.desc: How LLMs learn and generate, sampling, prompting, RAG and multimodal inputs.

modules.name: LLM internals
modules.desc: Positional embeddings, attention, the decoder block and the KV cache.

modules.name: Transformer walkthrough
modules.desc: Masked and multi-head attention, and the shapes through a transformer.

modules.name: Inference from the outside
modules.desc: What your provider optimises and how it shows up in price, latency and quality.

modules.name: Fine-tuning for app engineers
modules.desc: When to fine-tune, LoRA and QLoRA, data and distillation, preference tuning.

modules.name: Reasoning and verification
modules.desc: Reasoning models, chain of thought, tool calling and verification.

modules.name: MCP and agents
modules.desc: Context engineering, the agent loop, MCP, memory, multi-agent systems and agent security.

modules.name: Evals
modules.desc: Eval sets, graders and judges, RAG and agent evals, and regression testing in CI.

modules.name: Retrieval in depth
modules.desc: BM25, hybrid search, reranking, chunking, query transformation and keeping an index correct.

modules.name: LLM apps in production
modules.desc: Structured outputs, guardrails, prompt injection, cost, latency, reliability and observability.
